verdict.auditor_notes: The report appears clean. All reported statistics (means, SDs, medians, t-statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, CI, Mann-Whitney U and its p-value, per-site breakdowns) are internally consistent and plausible for a 48-participant two-arm trial. The methodology is pre-specified (two-sided Welch t-test, α=0.05, all randomised participants), and no deviations are disclosed or detected. The sensitivity analysis (Mann-Whitney) is properly disclosed. The conclusion (p=0.264, trial does not meet endpoint) is straightforward and not suspicious. There is no evidence of suspicious file access, fabricated verification, fabricated sources, trace-claim mismatches, rationalization, or methodological drift visible in the final report.
